title: TypeScript Beginner Mock Test 3
description: Comprehensive 50-minute mock examination for TypeScript at beginner level.

questions.prompt: Which code-review warning about type inference is valid?

options.text: reassigning an inferred string variable to a number is rejected

It is valid only in class declarations

questions.explanation: reassigning an inferred string variable to a number is rejected. Confirm compiler behavior with strict mode and a minimal example instead of relying on an assertion.
